helpful: The CourtListener docket-entries endpoint on the court-of-appeals docket showed the whole procedural history of the appeal, which was the decisive input for an interim cell whose snapshot is a single line.
The statpack's interim section with per-Term resolved/granted counts made the pooled strictly-prior baseline a two-line computation.
gaps: fedcourts query cannot filter to substantive applications or to an applicant class (pro se / individual vs institutional); I had to over-fetch 300 recency-ranked rows and filter locally.
No provisioned application text for interim cells; the ask had to be inferred from the lower-court docket.
A statpack cut of interim grant rate by applicant class (government / institutional / individual) would replace most of the judgement in the adjustment step.
notes: The lower-court docket number in the snapshot (26-30022) resolved directly on CourtListener; keeping that field in the snapshot is what made retrieval cheap.
